facts.function: therapeutic medicament for ulcers and GERD
facts.form: oral suspension 40 mg/5 mL, in measured doses/retail form

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3004 medicaments put up in measured doses or retail forms
GRI 6: 3004.90 other; 3004.90.92 other; medicaments primarily affecting the digestive system: containing famotidine

rejected_alternatives.reason: general digestive-system other line; a specific famotidine line exists
bulk famotidine chemical; this is a dosage form

classification.rationale: Famotidine oral suspension is a medicament in dosage form under heading 3004; the current tariff has a specific line for digestive-system medicaments containing famotidine. Ruling N339838 (famotidine injection) treated famotidine as a digestive-system medicament.
